source.credit: Tears of Steel (2012) (c) Blender Foundation | mango.blender.org

commands.release_frames: ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries frame=pict_type,pkt_size,pts_time -of json tears_of_steel_1080p.mov
commands.phone_clip: ffmpeg -ss <start> -to <end> -i tears_of_steel_1080p.mov -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 20 -g 48 -keyint_min 48 -sc_threshold 0 -bf 2 -pix_fmt yuv420p -an -movflags +faststart shot.mp4

pan_mvs.convention: displacement = dst - src: where the block IS now minus where it was copied FROM

pan_bits.note: x264 pass-1 stats; mv bucket includes macroblock headers

landscape.note: bytes per SECOND relative to the file's own average (x1.0 = average); first 640 s, credits excluded
landscape.phone_encode: scale=960 wide, libx264 veryfast crf 20, 2 s GOP (landscape only)

residual.note: 16x16 block; diff amplified x4 for display only; mean/max are raw 0-255 levels

heal.note: 16x16 macroblocks with no motion vector in the broken stream = built from scratch (intra)
